errors.problem: Engine regression against round-3 change 5 ('a word glossed as clitic + word is transliterated with a hyphen'). Many words whose segs gloss them as clitic + word ('and vegetables', 'and my certificate', 'for the night (of)', 'and for eighty', 'for two hundred') are transliterated without the hyphen, often in the same line as hyphenated ones: aruzz wa-dajāj wakhuḍār wazabādī; bi-miʾa junayh, wa-bithamānīna. Other examples: watadrusīna, wasanursilu, watuḥḍiru, wawishāḥ, waqīmatahā, wasanadfaʿu, wasahra, wamiʾatāni, walawz, wasayuḥaḍḍiruhu, wakhudhhā, bidīnārayni, bijunayhayn, bisiʿri, bimaraqi, limusāʿadatika, liwāliday, limuddati, litaghyīri. The Arabic is correct.
errors.fix: transliterate every seg-glossed clitic with a hyphen: wa-khuḍār wa-zabādī li-ʿashāʾi, wa-shahādatī, li-laylati, wa-bi-thamānīna, bi-miʾatayni …

notes.note: لِلَيْلَةِ السَّبْت is translated 'for Saturday night'. In traditional Arabic usage لَيْلَةُ السَّبْت is the night before Saturday (Friday night); many speakers still read it so. Consider a footnote or 'مَسَاءَ السَّبْت' if Saturday evening is meant.

summary: I read the whole scenarios-2 export (3,091 lines: 16 scenarios from airport-checkin to school, with dialogues, segs, mistake cards, quizzes and the scene photo spots) and opened the merged round-2 findings to avoid re-reporting fixes. I checked harakat and case endings against the syntax of each sentence (objects, idāfa, after prepositions, after إِنَّ/لٰكِنَّ/كَانَ/لَيْسَ, pause forms), verb moods after أَنْ/لَنْ/لَمْ/لَا, gender and dual agreement, number–noun rules (3–10 polarity, 11–99 singular accusative, hundreds and thousands, compound totals), the arithmetic of every total against the quiz keys, every quiz key and mistake card, and every tap and seg gloss. Checked: 579 Arabic strings (none wrong; the round-2 Arabic fixes — صَبَاحُ, أَيُّهُمَا, مِحْفَظَة, taqrīrani l-āna — are in place), 818 tap glosses on 366 tap lines (19 wrong or misleading, in 11 findings) and 2,864 seg glosses (none wrong). I found 13 errors, all minor: 11 gloss findings (seven of them round-2 scene/tap gloss findings that are still unchanged: الْمَكْتَب 'office' for counter/desk, الْعَرَبَة 'carriage', لِكُلِّ 'for all', هُوَ 'he' for a thing, سَيِّدَات 'toilets', السَّاعَة for the clock, طَابُور '(of)'; plus مُدِيرَة '(of)', خِزَانَةُ 'wardrobe', a duplicated sense in the new أَغْلَى two-readings gloss, and الْجَبَل 'mountain(s)'), one transliteration typo (mi'ati) and one engine regression: the new clitic-hyphen rule is applied inconsistently (wa-dajāj wakhuḍār wazabādī in one line). The dialogue Arabic, answer keys and grammar rules are correct throughout.
